capabilities: Display random Markdown notes, heading sections, and Canvas text/file nodes
Edit and save Markdown sections, whole files, and Canvas text nodes
Quickly append ideas to reviewed content
Filter candidates by folder and rebuild the index
Add, edit, and delete Canvas child nodes with automatic linking
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition scheduler; it resurfaces and edits existing note and Canvas content at random.
extras: README is written in Chinese; describes the current version as an MVP (0.1.4) requiring Obsidian 1.7.2 or later, and warns users to test write behavior in a separate vault.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated mobile-friendly workspace for resurfacing and acting on random existing content spread across notes, headings, and Canvas files.
summary: Mobile-first review view that shows random Markdown notes, heading sections, and Canvas nodes for reading, editing, and appending ideas.
